title: Deployment lattice with rollback advisor, shadow replay and automated bisect
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a unified deployment lattice controller with an explainable rollback advisor and shadow replay harness; exposes new telemetry anchors and a lightweight bisecter for rapid root-cause when regressions are detected.
description: Motivation: We need a single control plane primitive to coordinate staged canaries, A/B lanes and shadow traffic while making automated rollback decisions explainable to SREs and product owners. This PR introduces a 'deployment lattice' controller that composes safety gates, session-coherent promotes, and an offline-capable shadow-replay pipeline. Summary of changes: adds controller runtime, telemetry anchors, rollback advisor service, shadow replay worker, CLI for offline bisect, and new API hooks used by Redwood Console. Design notes: the advisor evaluates sliding-window metrics (latency P99, token failure-rate, A/B divergence) and recommends rollback decisions with provenance traces (metric deltas, contributing cohorts, time-series snippets). A small deterministic bisecter can run against replayed traffic slices to localize a revert commit candidate; the bisect output is surfaced as a human-review step in the Console. Checklist: - [x] controller runtime and CRD schema - [x] advisor evaluation rules + explainable traces - [x] shadow replay pipeline + perf harness - [x] CLI bisect integration and record format - [x] unit + integration tests for metric gates - [x] docs (console how-to + runbook) - [x] e2e smoke in staging (canary -> promote -> rollback) Backwards compatibility: controller registers a new CRD (DeploymentLattice). Existing rollout CRs are translated by a thin adapter and continue to function. No changes required for API consumers that use the top-level /deployments API. Testing and rollout plan: staged rollout to staging (region us-west-2) for two weeks, gated by telemetry anchors and synthetic smoke workloads. If advisor signals high risk, deployment is quarantined and shadow replay is run automatically. On detection of a regression, advisor suggests a revert and triggers an automated bisect run in replay mode; the bisect result is annotated into the proposal but requires a human approval to actually revert in prod. Related work: adapts parts of ENG-1977 (shadow fidelity sampler) and builds on telemetry schema from ENG-1921. Links: design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2145/deployment-lattice-design; runbook: https://docs.internal/redwood/deployment-lattice/runbook. Why unique: focuses on an explainable, provenance-backed rollback recommendation and pairs it with an offline replayable bisect path to shorten MTTI for regressions.

review_summary: PR opened by @maya-chen with a clear design and tests. Alejandro: requested the advisor include a confidence score and suggested adding a rate-limited path for automated quarantines to avoid flapping; left a requested change on advisor.go. Priya: asked for more telemetry sampling knobs and suggested storing minimal replay artifacts to S3 with retention policy; asked for docs updates to the runbook. Ethan: ran e2e in staging and found a race where promote+snapshot race leads to orphaned sessions; requested a patch in session_affinity.go. Author replies: committed fixes for confidence scoring and added exponential backoff to quarantine transitions; added S3 retention config and updated runbook with operational playbook; fixed race in session_affinity with a small mutex and added a test. Post-fix CI passed; Priya and Alejandro approved; Ethan approved after successful staging run. Final approval comment: "Approving - safety checks green, staging smoke looks good, playbook in place" (Alejandro).
